realtime_subjects_timelapse_world.label: Real-time characters / time-lapse world
realtime_subjects_timelapse_world.guidance: Create a clearly separated two-speed reality: protected characters remain in natural real time while only the unprotected background world moves in smooth accelerated time-lapse.

frozen_world.label: Characters move / world frozen
frozen_world.guidance: Protected characters move naturally through a world frozen at one instant. Unprotected people, particles, vehicles, liquids, smoke, weather, and environmental motion remain suspended unless the scene explicitly releases one element.

reverse_world.label: Characters forward / world reverses
reverse_world.guidance: Protected characters move and perform forward in natural time while unprotected background people and environmental events visibly run in reverse, including recoverable spills, retracing traffic, returning debris, and reversed weather or smoke.

day_night_sweep.label: Real-time characters / day-to-night sweep
day_night_sweep.guidance: Protected characters remain in natural time while the environment passes rapidly through a readable day-to-night or night-to-day cycle, with accelerated sky color, sunlight angle, shadow travel, window light, and practical lights switching on or off.

seasonal_passage.label: Real-time characters / seasons pass
seasonal_passage.guidance: Protected characters remain in natural time while the environment transitions through accelerated seasonal change: vegetation, weather, ground cover, atmospheric color, and daylight evolve coherently without changing the characters' identities or wardrobe unless explicitly requested.

crowd_flow.label: Real-time characters / crowd river
crowd_flow.guidance: Protected characters remain sharply readable in natural time while anonymous unreferenced extras flow around them as an accelerated crowd river, forming continuous directional streams without duplicating, replacing, or obscuring the protected cast.

looping_background.label: Real-time characters / looping background
looping_background.guidance: Protected characters continue naturally while unprotected background actions repeat in deliberate seamless temporal loops. Keep each loop spatially anchored and visually distinct from the protected characters' unrepeated performance.

delayed_world.label: Characters lead / world echoes behind
delayed_world.guidance: Protected characters move in natural time while unprotected environmental reactions lag behind them in visible delayed echoes, as though the world responds one beat late. Preserve physical readability and avoid duplicating the protected characters.

living_shadows.label: Real-time characters / living shadows
living_shadows.guidance: Protected characters remain in natural time while cast shadows and environmental shadows move independently at accelerated speed, changing direction and shape without changing the protected characters' bodies, faces, or identity.

reflection_delay.label: Real-time characters / delayed reflections
reflection_delay.guidance: Protected characters move in natural time while their reflections and the environment's reflections respond with a deliberate temporal delay. Keep the real characters singular and stable; the delayed imagery exists only inside physically plausible reflective surfaces.

gravity_separation.label: Real-time characters / altered-gravity world
gravity_separation.guidance: Protected characters remain grounded and move in natural time while unprotected loose objects, dust, fabric scraps, droplets, leaves, and environmental debris rise, fall, or drift under visibly altered gravity.

audio_direction: Temporal speed separation is visual only. Keep supplied or generated dialogue, singing, lip sync, facial timing, and primary audio at normal speed; never time-stretch, reverse, or accelerate protected voices.
